title: ONINAKI Demo
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#937, 2026-11-03), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.24, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, D3DMetal, rated 3 of 5 after 15 minutes: it played well until it crashed at a healing point when Start was pressed. The backtrace shows a write to address 0 at ntdll+0x38314, nested many times through exception handling. The log attached is from the uninstall run. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playing well on an M1 with D3DMetal until a crash after about 15 minutes. A Unity game.

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes after a while, here at a healing point when Start was pressed (M1, D3DMetal, Wine 10 r29)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. The backtrace shows a write to address 0 inside Wine's ntdll (+0x38314) while it was handling an exception, nested many times over
